description: This file defines classes and functions for managing cookies, including Cookie and CookieStore classes, cookie parsing, and domain/path matching logic, used within the Playwright core server.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Represents an HTTP cookie with methods for matching URLs, equality check, and expiration management.

classes.name: CookieStore
classes.description: Manages a collection of cookies, allowing addition, retrieval, and cleanup of expired cookies.

methods.name: parseRawCookie
methods.description: Parses a Set-Cookie header string into a RawCookie object.

methods.name: domainMatches
methods.description: Checks if a hostname matches a cookie domain according to RFC rules.

methods.name: pathMatches
methods.description: Checks if a URL path matches a cookie path according to RFC rules.
